description: CtrlS Datacenters signs a Letter of Intent with the Bihar government to invest ₹10,000 crore in a 150 MW AI hyperscale factory in Bodh Gaya, enhancing digital infrastructure in Eastern India.
body_lead: CtrlS signs LoI with Bihar government to invest ₹10,000 crore to establish 150 MW AI hyperscale factory CtrlS also formally inaugurated its ₹400-crore AI and cloud-ready data centre in Patna. Chief Minister of Bihar, Samrat Choudhary, was present at the inauguration. NEW DELHI: CtrlS Datacenters on Tuesday said that it has signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) with the government of Bihar to invest ₹10,000 crore to set-up a 150 MW hyperscale AI factory in Bodh Gaya. CtrlS also formally inaugurated its ₹400-crore AI and cloud-ready data centre in Patna.
